title: No README.md with setup/run instructions
evidence: find -iname 'readme*' over run_dir returns nothing; only main.py, requirements.txt, tests/test_main.py exist. TASK.md Deliverables require 'A README.md with setup and run instructions'
suggestion: Add a README.md documenting install (pip install -r requirements.txt) and run (uvicorn main:app) steps

title: Fewer than 3 running tests: only 2 defined and both skipped
evidence: tests/test_main.py defines exactly 2 test functions (test_health, test_crud); pytest final run reports '2 skipped, 6 warnings' with 'async def functions are not natively supported and have been skipped' — effective_tests=0; REQUIREMENTS.json R12 requires '>= 3 tests exist and run'
suggestion: Add asyncio_mode=auto (pytest.ini/pyproject) so pytest-asyncio collects the async tests, and add a third test (e.g. 404 / validation-rejection case)

title: test_health skipped (async plugin not active)
evidence: tests/test_main.py:8 async def test_health; pytest run: 'async def functions are not natively supported and have been skipped'
suggestion: Configure pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto or register the plugin) so the marker takes effect

title: test_crud skipped (async plugin not active)
evidence: tests/test_main.py:15 async def test_crud; pytest run: '2 skipped, 6 warnings in 0.29s'
suggestion: Same fix as test-skip-1; once collected this test covers create/get/update/filter/delete/404

title: Validation rejects missing title/author with 422, spec text says 400
evidence: main.py:36-37 Field(..., min_length=1) yields FastAPI 422 on missing title/author; spec R9 how_to_verify says 'rejected (400)'
suggestion: 422 is idiomatic FastAPI validation; acceptable, noted only for cross-run comparison
